_about: Snapshot of airline identity and grievance-route evidence gathered through Crustdata (/company/identify, /web/enrich/live) on 2026-11-22. The app replays this snapshot when no CRUSTDATA_API_KEY is set; with a key it refreshes through flightback.crustdata. Contact details are dated records, not guarantees: airlines' own pages disagree on officer names, so email addresses and the retrieval time are what the case packet quotes.

identity.name: Air India Limited
identity.note: company_type_label is Crustdata's classification and is not used in any decision.

grievance.passage:
The passenger first has to write to the Customer Support team at our customer support portal (https://www.airindia.com/in/en/contact-us/customer-support-portal.html); after reviewing the grievance, the Customer Support agent will share the resolution.
If the passenger is not satisfied with the response of the Customer Support agent, then they can quote their grievance to the Nodal Officer, who may be contacted at nodalofficer@airindia.com.
If the passenger is still unsatisfied and wishes to appeal, they can lodge an appeal with our Appellate Authority at appellateauthority@airindia.com quoting their grievance.
The passenger can also log in to the AirSewa (https://airsewa.gov.in/#/home) portal to submit grievances.
Kindly note that for speedy redressal of your grievance, while escalating your grievance to Nodal officer or Appellate Authority, it is advisable to have a valid customer support Case ID raised at customer support portal mentioned above.
Nodal Officer: Mr. Abdesh Kumar
E-Mail: nodalofficer@airindia.com
Appellate Authority: Ms. Bhavna Tiwari
E-Mail: appellateauthority@airindia.com
conflicts: A search result for Air India's passenger-rights page appeared to be old; names may have changed.
grievance.advice: Raise a customer-support Case ID first and quote it when escalating to the nodal officer or appellate authority.
